Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Class DevSmsInboxController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.DevSmsInboxController
All Implemented Interfaces:
DevSmsInboxPageApi
@Controller @Profile("dev") public class DevSmsInboxController extends Object implements DevSmsInboxPageApi
Development only (dev profile): renders the SMS messages the logging sender recorded instead of sending them, so a developer or an end-to-end test can read the code of a sign-in or of a phone enrolment. The page is as the contract apis/auth-server/web-pages/auth-server-pages-v1.yaml describes it through the generated DevSmsInboxPageApi. The inbox exists only while the logging sender is in use, so it is looked up lazily: with a real gateway configured the page is empty. It is a documented exception to the rule that src/main holds no demo-only code (the end-to-end tests run the packaged jar, so it cannot live in src/test); it is inert in every other profile because the controller is not even created.
